title: Web Page to Markdown for AI & RAG
description: Turn any web page into clean Markdown for LLMs, RAG and AI agents: main content only (no menus, ads or footers), absolute links and images, tables kept, title/author/date metadata, word and token counts, optional chunks. Respects robots.txt. Pay per page, errors free.

urls.title: Page URLs
urls.description: Pages to convert, one per line (up to 10,000 per run).

extractMode.title: What to keep
extractMode.description: Main content removes menus, footers, cookie banners and sidebars.

chunkTokens.title: Chunk size for RAG (tokens)
chunkTokens.description: 0 = no chunks. Otherwise also split the Markdown into chunks of about this many tokens on paragraph boundaries, each with its section heading.

includeLinks.title: Include list of links
includeLinks.description: Also return every absolute link found on the page.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages the site asks bots not to fetch. Recommended.

page.title: Page converted
page.description: One page fetched and converted to Markdown. Unreachable, blocked, empty or error pages are free.

store.seoTitle: Web Page to Markdown for LLM, RAG and AI Agents
store.seoDescription: Convert URLs to clean Markdown for LLMs and RAG: main content only, metadata, token counts, chunks. Respects robots.txt. $1 per 1,000 pages.
